_comment: Models downloaded on first run. Two files, about 465 MB: a voice detector and a speech recogniser covering Russian and English. Both run on the device and neither ever leaves it.

models.notes: Gates ASR so speech recognition only runs on actual speech. Tiny, and the single biggest battery saving in the pipeline. Without it the app falls back to an energy threshold.

Russian, English and 23 other European languages, detected automatically per utterance — no setting to choose one. Same architecture and file layout as the v2 it replaces (encoder.int8.onnx, decoder.int8.onnx, joiner.int8.onnx, tokens.txt), so it runs through the same engine at the same cost. Until it has downloaded, the v2 already on the phone keeps transcribing, in English.
